Name: Monsters as Enemies from Kirby
Author: CandyConstellation
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replaces monsters with a variety of cute Kirby enemies.
All sprites were drawn and edited by myself, although some sprites heavily reference their original, official sprite work.
Requires Content Patcher.[/color][color=#D4D4D8]
